about: R2-LEVELS LP0 (design_docs/planned/r2/levels.md §A7, ledger D-103): the bridge as a one-stage level, as data. The game still reads the bridge's views from data/camera/views.json until LP1b; this manifest is what the level evaluator and levels-regress measure, so the bridge has a regression baseline from day one. Ship frame (x, y = the bow, z = up), metres; view yaw in ShipCamera's convention (270 = the bow). The deck's walk is the shipped walk_bridge.glb (surfaces[].walk).

spire.note: the bridge's own rig (R2-BRIDGE-STYLE); not driven from this manifest
